notes.title: The free The Darkest Tales - Into the Nightmare prologue’s been launched!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! Hope you’re doing great.

Today we are glad to introduce to you The Darkest Tales - Into the Nightmare. It’s a free prologue of The Darkest Tales - an action-platformer set in a dreamy yet dangerous world of childhood nightmares where you play as a stuffed plush toy Teddy trying to save his little owner Alicia.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747650/The_Darkest_Tales__Into_the_Nightmare/

Check the official prologue trailer:
[previewyoutube=J-eqhJxowHo;full][/previewyoutube]

Key Features: 

●	Get your hands on sharp enchanted weapons and jump, slice, and dash your way through anyone who stands in your way.
●	Develop your skill tree to learn a ton of new tricks that include faster healing, more damage, and much more!
●	You may remember them differently… Do battle with a ton of once-friendly, now deadly, fairytale characters turned evil bosses. First up? A double blade-wielding, deceiving Little Red Riding Hood 
●	Fully voiced characters, a rich storyline filled with recognizable fairy tale lore, and gorgeous yet haunting landscapes and levels.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747650/The_Darkest_Tales__Into_the_Nightmare/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1747650/extras/%D0%9C%D0%B8%D1%88%D0%BA%D0%B0%D0%9C%D0%B5%D1%87.gif?t=1634215258[/img][/url]
All progress saved in the prologue will be automatically carried over into the full version of The Darkest Tales upon launch.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747650/The_Darkest_Tales__Into_the_Nightmare/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1747650/extras/%D1%84%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B03.gif?t=1634215258[/img][/url]
Download The Darkest Tales - Into the Nightmare for free today and don’t forget to share your feedback in this form https://forms.gle/7pvZzC31rX7U8A6C9 or our official Discord server https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/vYQaVv4X53

notes.title: New mechanics in Slaps And Beans 2
notes.notes:
In Slaps And Beans 2 the combat system and its progression will be enhanced and improved. This will be done through the use of new environmental interactions (especially with Terence), improved combos to create single or co-operative attacks, and the addition of new power-ups.
Here are a few examples: 


[previewyoutube=3VNAJlbi1Zg;full][/previewyoutube]
Improved Terence's dodging ability. When Terence dodges a hit near a wall or obstacle the enemy will be confused and vulnerable.


[previewyoutube=wsURVfHSEXA;full][/previewyoutube]
Terence will be able to use his speed to "lock" hordes of enemies and lead them towards Bud or a trap.


[previewyoutube=Nk4gPIS_VEs;full][/previewyoutube]
New power-ups will temporarily increase players' abilities and certain gameplay parameters (strength, speed, damage resistance, time running speed, etc.).

notes.title: Slaps And Beans 2
notes.notes:
Today, September 16, 2021 the Trinity Team and Buddy Production are launching the Kickstarter campaign for the long-awaited follow-up project: the second part of Slaps And Beans, the official video game of Bud Spencer and Terence Hill.

Upon reaching the campaign objective of Slaps And Beans 2, there will be a brand new story, new mini-games, a 4-player party mode and many other new features. The most interesting stretch goals include voice synchronization (with voices of Michele Gammino, Tilo Schmitz and Dennis Schmidt-Foß) and a release for the latest generation of consoles.

To support the project and to find out more details, visit the following page
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1684041218/bud-spencer-and-terence-hill-slaps-and-beans-2

notes.title: FULL RELEASE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31415445/121552f8c6eea712018750add4a28070e723a87f.gif[/img]

Today, ‘Bud Spencer & Terence Hill – Slaps and Beans’ comes out to slap from the Early Access!
 
We particularly want to thank all the fans all over the world who have helped us to improve the game in these months, and we invite them to play it again: they will find new minigames, improved graphics and combat system, new areas to explore, new enemies, more than 30 achievements, Steam Cards and much more! We have also translated the game in plenty new languages, including Chinese and Russian (and Japanese is coming!)
 
Full Release does not mean that we will abandon the game: we will continue to support it with new updates and content as we have always done, so it's a simple change of label that the game now deserves thanks to everyone's passion.

So, thanks to  you all and enjoy the full release of Slaps and Beans!
